name: step-pointer-single-pointer-form
description: pointer step, single-touch form: down on a selector, wait, move to absolute coordinates, up.
yaml:
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down: "Item A"
          - wait: 800
          - move: { x: 300, y: 600 }
          - up
    moveDurationMs: 300
